entries.issue: invoke-docker.sh sourced runtime/master.env after explicit environment, overriding the per-run project ID and master key; D-checks queried empty projects.
entries.fix: Explicit APPSECGATE_PROJECT_ID and APPSECGATE_MASTER_API_KEY now take precedence; POLICY is configurable for T-08.
entries.resume: Invalidated the first cycle01 attempt and restarted the complete three-model cycle with clean data directories.

entries.issue: D1/D4 accepted empty equality, D2 had no timestamps because findings lack master_received_at, and eval lacked the required critical-TP metric.
entries.fix: D1/D4 now require nonempty edge findings; D2 uses audit received_at; eval reports critical TP precision/recall/F1 and leaves FP F1 null without FP ground truth.
entries.resume: Recompute metrics for every clean cycle01 run; no product code or prompt changed.

entries.issue: Initial gate fixtures masked unresolved_local behind ci_severity, scanned PyGoat in one repeated case, patched only one of nine Django CVEs, and suppressed only one finding.
entries.fix: Isolated every repeated run to gate_project, added explicit policies, upgrade T-03 to Django 5.2.8, and create CI suppressions for all target findings.
entries.resume: Invalidated gate01 and restarted all T-01…T-08 for all models as gate01r2 with clean project/data IDs.

entries.issue: T-05 failed on every model: CiGateConfig.block_on_unresolved_local=false was pulled and loaded but SHOWN was blocked unconditionally.
entries.fix: Gate matrix now checks block_on_unresolved_local for SHOWN; regression test added.
entries.approval: Approved by the user as fix 1/3 on 2026-11-02.
entries.resume: Run make check, rebuild the canonical image, and repeat the complete Stage 1A/1B cycle 1.

entries.issue: Qwen and GLM intermittently returned invalid verdict objects or finding IDs; six diagnostic cycles gave 72.2% overall stability.
entries.fix: Use strict JSON Schema, temperature=0, and one protocol-only retry per finding; expose protocol_retries in usage. Prompt unchanged.
entries.approval: User explicitly requested stabilization before Stage 2 on 2026-11-02.
entries.resume: Validate and rebuild, then restart acceptance numbering from cycle 1; previous cycles remain diagnostic.

entries.issue: The patch evaluator passed a relative patch path after changing cwd, so git apply could not open the file and every valid proposal was scored as unapplicable.
entries.fix: Pass patch.resolve() to git apply and recompute all stabilized acceptance and DeepSeek patch metrics.
entries.resume: Corrected totals: Qwen 38/38, GLM 16/100, Gemma4 0/69, DeepSeek 65/70. No product code changed.
